newsitem.title: CANADA: Prairie elevator space, railcar port unloads - CWB.
newsitem.headline: Prairie elevator space, railcar port unloads - CWB.

text.p: The Canadian Wheat Board on Tuesday detailed the proportion of space available in Prairie primary elevators as well as how may rail hopper cars unloaded at export positions for the week ended August 23.
Manitoba elevators had 55 percent of space available, Alberta showed 49 percent of space available and Saskatchewan reported 40 percent of space available, the CWB said.
Primary elevators along Canadian National Railway Co lines showed more space than Canadian Pacific Ltd's CP Rail System lines.
West coast hopper car unloads totalled 2,666 cars.
Thunder Bay hopper car unloads totalled 1,617 cars.
Churchill hopper car unloads totalled 233 cars.
